verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair privacy-posture question for an agent framework, but the evidence pack contains no documented region or residency selection in AutoGen or AutoGen Studio. Running teams in Docker or exporting them to Python is a user-side deployment arrangement, not a product residency control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
